description: Transition plugin hooks for any project that enables transition@local. PreCompact adds handoff-style instructions to the built-in compaction summary (its stdout reaches the summarizer; verified 2026-10-23). PostCompact copies that summary, minus the <analysis> scratch block, to .workspace/transitions/YYYY-MM-DD/HHMMSS.md, so it outlives transcript retention and Codex or other sessions can read it. No extra model call. Both resolve their target from $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. init-transition.sh is kept but unregistered.
